title: Factorisation, gradients and a rank obstruction
promptMarkdown: Let T=diag(3,1), X=I₂, W₁=diag(0.5,1), W₂=diag(1,0.5), and L=½||W₂W₁−T||²_F. Calculate product, loss and both matrix gradients. Show an invertible hidden rescaling that preserves the product. Prove that a hidden width 1 cannot exactly represent T, and justify a minimum rank-one squared error of1.
hintLadder: Differentiate the product through each factor while holding the other fixed.
Use a null vector of a rank-one2×2 matrix.
